select count(id) as cultivateNum, count(DISTINCT theme_id) as themeNum, sum(IF(exam_task_id is not null,1,0)) as examNum, sum(IF(cultivate_mode = 'ONLINE',1,0)) as onlineNum, sum(IF(cultivate_mode = 'OFFLINE',1,0)) as offlineNum, sum(IF(cultivate_target = 'STAFF',1,0)) as staffNum, sum(IF(cultivate_target = 'MERCHANT',1,0)) as merchantNum from cultivate_task t where t.deleted = 0
and t.cultivate_start_time >= #{period.begin} and t.cultivate_start_time < #{period.end}

select count(tu.id) as trainNum, sum(IF(tu.user_sign_status = 'SIGNED',1,0)) AS signedNum, sum(IF(tu.user_sign_status = 'UNSIGNED',1,0)) AS unsignedNum, sum(IF(tu.belated = 1,1,0)) AS belatedNum from cultivate_task_user tu inner join cultivate_task t on tu.cultivate_task_id = t.id
and t.cultivate_start_time >= #{period.begin} and t.cultivate_start_time < #{period.end}

select count(*) as total_num from cultivate_task t
and t.cultivate_start_time >= #{query.period.begin} and t.cultivate_start_time < #{query.period.end}
